title: Colonal Panorama
description: Turn the Menu Panorama into Colonal's Builds!
body:
The Colonal Panorama Resource Pack turns the Menu Panormal into Colonals Villager Trading Hall Lobby!

It is themed around Colonal's Builds, and optimized for to be used in the [Colonal Mod Pack (CMP)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/colonal-pack).
